The complete 44-case focused module passed across the preserved 23 completed cases and the targeted 21-case remainder.

evidence.claim: All seven artifact hashes and the canonical aggregate control-plane hash matched the frozen identities.
Evidence is bound to workflow, epoch, step, attempt, authorization receipt, source commit, source snapshot, artifact bytes, subjects, and policy-owned assertions.
Production CI validation checks live GitHub run identity and attempt and verifies result and subject attestations against exact digests; grouped evidence rejects mixed attempts.
Authorization is limited to current S14 or S15 attempts and bound to exact scope, actions, source snapshot, candidate hash, epoch, and receipt hash.
Migration and replan parse and hash one bounded captured byte buffer, archive those exact bytes, and reject archive collisions.
Canonical orphan failure receipts are replayed under the workflow lock, while malformed, noncanonical, incorrectly named, or state-unbound receipts fail closed.

Focused tests passed for failure replay, noncanonical or renamed failure rejection, exact migration archival, replan preservation, attempt scoping, event-chain linkage, and failed-worktree non-promotion.
The contract, schema, verifier policy, atomic-write owner, lock owner, and canonical transaction owner have explicit and closed responsibilities.

Read bounds, closed policy coverage, stable evidence definitions, typed failure codes, and centralized validation constrain behavior, although the 4522-line controller remains a substantial maintenance surface.
